findings.what: During the flight the Lumi panel still says 'looking over the newest things'. The 'Lumi' name tag sits on top of the chick and the music-note emote, which makes it a little cluttered. The flight only starts between 09:00 and 18:00, every 40-70 min.

summary: I forced a flight in the sandbox and checked it: Lumi flies high over the island at sunset with the chick on its back and a 'Flying! Really flying!' bubble, and the camera frames it well. Frame time is about 4.4 ms median. The kite 'Play, Stop, Play again' failure is still open although #331 is marked done.
surprise_why: A real flight with a rider and the camera alongside is a nice twist, but it is one more timed event next to the existing crash flight.
